notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God and Shabraz trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shabraz trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
